description: Fork of exp646 (tiny SOTA = 1.4939 @ 48.76M, bs=16). Single change: E (embedding_dim) 96 -> 192. Side effects: tok_emb_E doubles (+3.15M); out_proj n_outputs doubles weights/layer (+1.57M/layer = +9.44M total). Expected total params ~61.36M. Reference: exp646 = 1.4939, exp645 (E=96) = 1.5025, exp643 (E=48) = 1.5134, vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882. exp645 E48->96 gave -10.9mb at +6.3M params.
